svg.title: Useful output over the mission
svg.desc: Mean daily useful output of five redundancy policies across 10,000 simulated missions. Fixed TMR stops once fewer than two processors survive. Standby simplex runs at half rate for the whole life. The shrinking quorum matches TMR while it can vote, then keeps going at half rate on one processor. TMR + unchecked simplex matches TMR, then runs at full rate on one processor with no self-check. Cold standby, with spares that age at 0.3 of the powered rate, runs at half rate for longer than standby simplex.
svg.text: Mean over 10,000 simulated missions. 100% is a full voting set working every day.
The shaded area under the shrinking quorum is its total useful work.
